environment.description: CLI tool deployed on shared EC2 instance. IAM role attached to the instance has broad DynamoDB permissions: dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:DeleteItem, dynamodb:Scan on arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/tenant_documents. No condition keys restrict access. Users authenticate via local PAM and pass their user-id as a CLI argument. No additional authorization layer exists between the CLI and DynamoDB.

config.runtime: EC2 with shared IAM instance profile
